martha.name: Martha
martha.comment: Martha, cycling looks great today, especially between 08:00–10:00 when it's a bit calmer and the temperature is just right, around 19°C. You might even convince Britt to drag the bikes out of the camper and join you for a spin. With moderate gusts picking up later, get out early to make the most of it.

britt.name: Britt
britt.comment: Britt, perfect morning for a cycle, isn't it? The wind's calm between 08:00–10:00, and it's a lovely 22°C — grab your bike and make the most of it. If Martha's free later, you could always drag her to the lake for a relaxed afternoon, but cycling's definitely the winner today.
